measure: language laws on the library's own text

zipf.method: least-squares slope of log frequency on log rank, ranks 1 to 1000; bootstrap over documents, 200 draws
zipf.label: measured

heaps.method: least-squares fit of log V on log n, 50 checkpoints, index order
heaps.label: measured

limits: Latin-script words only; captions are short and mixed-language, and talk transcripts are auto captions. The slope over ranks 1 to 1000 is a summary, not a test that the law holds; a maximum-likelihood power-law fit was not run.
